images.title: ちそう 1
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: background image for a fossil-finding game for a 4-year-old, no interactive subjects baked into the background.
Primary request: a bright, friendly illustrated cliff face with clear horizontal bands of geological strata.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted educational game illustration, gentle natural stone textures, soft edges and sunny cheerful lighting, not a photograph and not an infographic.
Composition/framing: landscape 4:3 image, the nearly front-facing layered cliff fills most of the frame; broad open areas across the whole cliff face to overlay three small separately provided fossil specimen cutouts later. Keep vegetation to a thin rim at the very top and a small amount of gravel at the bottom. Clearly recognizable, continuous horizontal layers. Low-to-medium texture contrast so small detailed fossil overlays will be visible.
Constraints: render ONLY the environment. No fossils, bones, skeletons, dinosaurs, animals, people, tools, signs, targets, marked circles, letters, text, labels, logos, watermarks or borders. Opaque full-scene background, no transparency. Not a literal age-specific geological reconstruction. Both variants should look cohesive as a pair.

Scene/backdrop: a broad pale sandstone cliff with soft cream, buff, pale peach and light ochre horizontal layers; subtle rounded ledges, sparse grass on the upper rim. Gentle warm daylight. Most of the rock surface is light rather than deep brown, for contrast with warm-brown fossil cutouts. No cave or hole, no foreground object dominating the playable cliff face.
